title: Settings
summary: App-wide settings: the company profile (name, legal name, address, NPWP, phone, email, time zone, logo) other modules use on documents (SettingsClient), and a settings page other modules add sections to (slot settings:sections). Every change audited.
when_to_use: The app prints or sends documents with the company's details, or needs one place for app-wide settings.
when_not_to_use: Several companies (tenants) in one app — this keeps one profile.

ports.name: FileStore
ports.description: Store the uploaded logo. Without it the logo cannot be uploaded; everything else works.

permissions.name: settings.manage
permissions.description: Mengubah pengaturan aplikasi dan profil perusahaan
